title: Deep learning-enabled assessment of right ventricular size and function is associated with cardiovascular outcomes.

abstract: [Nature cardiovascular research] Right ventricular (RV) size and function inform prognosis in many cardiovascular diseases, but assessment by two-dimensional transthoracic echocardiography is challenging. Here we show that a deep learning model, Dimensional Reconstruction of Imaging Data-Right Ventricle (DROID-RV), can estimate RV end-diastolic diameter and identify RV systolic dysfunction from transthoracic echocardiography videos. We trained DROID-RV in 17,141 ambulatory cardiology patients (51,188 studies and 383,881 video clips) and validated model predictions in 9,112 primary care patients and 831 patients with RV ejection fraction assessed by three-dimensional transthoracic echocardiography. Across multiple test samples, DROID-RV accurately estimates RV end-diastolic diameter and identifies RV dysfunction, although model prediction error increases at extremes of RV size and function. We additionally show that RV size and function predictions are associated with incident mortality, atrial fibrillation and heart failure. Our work demonstrates how deep learning can automate RV assessment and risk stratification at scale using two-dimensional echocardiography.
zh_abstract: [Nature cardiovascular research] 右心室（RV）大小和功能可为许多心血管疾病提供预后信息，但通过二维经胸超声心动图进行评估具有挑战性。在此我们表明，深度学习模型 Dimensional Reconstruction of Imaging Data-Right Ventricle（DROID-RV，影像数据维度重建-右心室）能够从经胸超声心动图视频中估计 RV 舒张末期内径并识别 RV 收缩功能障碍。我们在 17,141 名门诊心脏病患者（51,188 次检查和 383,881 个视频片段）中训练 DROID-RV，并在 9,112 名初级保健患者和 831 名通过三维经胸超声心动图评估 RV 射血分数的患者中验证模型预测。在多个测试样本中，DROID-RV 能准确估计 RV 舒张末期内径并识别 RV 功能障碍，尽管在 RV 大小和功能的极端值时模型预测误差增加。我们进一步表明，RV 大小和功能预测与新发死亡、心房颤动和心力衰竭相关。我们的工作展示了深度学习如何利用二维超声心动图在大规模上自动化 RV 评估和风险分层。

title: Indirect Influences of Artificial Intelligence Advice on Complex Sepsis Treatment Decisions

abstract: Sepsis is a major public health concern, and many sepsis patients die due to ineffective hemodynamic management. Artificial intelligence could support hemodynamic decisions, particularly in complex cases where conflicting information and comorbidities drive uncertainty and practice variation. However, these systems' real-world value depends on not just accuracy, but how they influence the quality of clinician decisions. We first retrospectively evaluated an AI system's recommendations in 6,928 sepsis patients, finding that they improved upon the original providers' decisions overall but had significantly worse performance in complex cases. We then conducted a pre-registered experiment with 228 US critical care physicians to test their use of this imperfect advice in six complex treatment decisions, using one of three advice types designed to vary reasoning autonomy. Participants given simple model recommendations overcame poor advice, choosing optimal treatments in 56.3% of decisions compared to 31.8% if they had always followed the recommendations. They also made significantly better decisions than those receiving a less prescriptive advice type (42.9%). Physicians selectively adapted and improved weak advice, likely because it prompted them to reconsider their assessment. Our findings suggest that improving sepsis care decisions with AI may require accounting for these indirect influences resulting from human-AI collaborative reasoning.
zh_abstract: 脓毒症是一个重大公共卫生问题，许多脓毒症患者因血流动力学管理无效而死亡。人工智能可支持血流动力学决策，尤其是在信息冲突和合并症导致不确定性和实践差异的复杂病例中。然而，这些系统在真实世界中的价值不仅取决于准确性，还取决于它们如何影响临床医生决策的质量。我们首先回顾性评估了一个 AI 系统在 6,928 例脓毒症患者中的建议，发现其总体上改进了原始提供者的决策，但在复杂病例中表现显著更差。随后，我们开展了一项预注册实验，纳入 228 名美国重症监护医生，测试他们在六项复杂治疗决策中如何使用这种不完美的建议，采用三种旨在改变推理自主性的建议类型之一。接受简单模型建议的参与者在 56.3% 的决策中选择了最佳治疗，相比之下，若他们始终遵循建议则为 31.8%，从而克服了较差建议。他们做出的决策也显著优于接受规定性较弱建议类型者（42.9%）。医生有选择地调整并改进了弱建议，很可能是因为该建议促使他们重新考虑自己的评估。我们的发现表明，用 AI 改善脓毒症诊疗决策可能需要考虑人-AI 协作推理产生的这些间接影响。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Fondazione Policlinico Universitario Agostino Gemelli IRCCS; conditions: Breast Neoplasms; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 200075; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] The goal of this observational study is to evaluate how artificial intelligence (AI) can be integrated into an organized breast cancer screening program for women aged 50-74 years undergoing mammography screening. The main questions it aims to answer are: * Can an AI-based workflow that identifies selected mammograms for review by a third radiologist improve or maintain the cancer detection rate compared with the current AI-supported double-reading workflow? * How would this AI-based workflow affect recall rates, biopsy referrals, false-positive results, interval cancers, radiologists' workload, and the number of cases requiring third-reader review? Researchers will compare the currently used screening strategy, in which mammograms are independently read by two radiologists with AI support, with an alternative AI-based strategy reconstructed using a target trial emulation approach. In the alternative strategy, predefined AI score thresholds will be used to identify selected cases for an offline review by an independent third radiologist. Participants will not be asked to undergo additional examinations or changes to their clinical care. Researchers will use routinely collected mammography screening data, AI scores, radiologists' readings, screening outcomes, and follow-up information. The alternative AI-based screening workflow will be evaluated retrospectively and will not affect participants' screening results or clinical management.

abstract: [The Journal of legal medicine] The Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) seeks to leverage the unprecedented capabilities of artificial intelligence (AI) through its newest Innovation Center approach known as the Wasteful and Inappropriate Services Reduction Model (WISeR). WISeR will redefine traditional Medicare claim approval operations through AI-driven prior authorization requirements imposed on beneficiaries seeking certain medical services. WISeR exposes beneficiaries to improper claim denials and delayed or forgone care. However, its greatest flaw is that it cannot be legally classified as a "model" at all. Congress has not defined what constitutes a "model" in establishing the Innovation Center, leaving it to CMS's interpretion. But WISeR contrasts starkly with previous Innovation Center models: It imposes substantial mandatory obligations on Medicare providers yet remains classified as voluntary, avoiding formal notice and comment procedures. WISeR also represents the first model that transfers CMS decision-making processes entirely to private companies. WISeR is not a "model," but an attempt to circumvent formal rulemaking processes regarding Medicare claims through AI-driven coverage decisions. Post-Chevron deference, courts, and not administrative agencies, are empowered to decide what Congress means when its legislative guidance is ambiguous. Consequently, courts should find that WISeR is not a "model" and must undergo a formal rulemaking process.
zh_abstract: [法律医学杂志] 美国医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心（Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, CMS）试图通过其最新的创新中心（Innovation Center）方法——浪费和不适当服务削减模型（Wasteful and Inappropriate Services Reduction Model, WISeR）——来利用人工智能（AI）前所未有的能力。WISeR 将通过对寻求某些医疗服务的受益人施加 AI 驱动的事前授权要求，重新定义传统的 Medicare 索赔审批操作。WISeR 使受益人面临不当索赔拒绝以及延迟或放弃照护的风险。然而，其最大缺陷在于，它在法律上根本无法被归类为“模型”。国会在设立创新中心时并未界定什么构成“模型”，而将其留给 CMS 解释。但 WISeR 与以往的创新中心模型形成鲜明对比：它对 Medicare 提供者施加了大量强制性义务，却仍被归类为自愿性，从而规避了正式的通知与评论程序。WISeR 还代表了首个将 CMS 决策过程完全转移给私人公司的模型。WISeR 不是“模型”，而是试图通过 AI 驱动的覆盖决策来规避有关 Medicare 索赔的正式规则制定程序。在 Chevron 尊让原则被推翻之后，法院而非行政机构有权决定：当立法指引模糊时，国会意味着什么。因此，法院应认定 WISeR 不是“模型”，并且必须经历正式规则制定程序。

title: Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Ultrasound for Sarcopenia Assessment: A Scoping Review.

abstract: [Journal of the American Geriatrics Society] Muscle ultrasound offers a portable, non-invasive, and cost-effective option for sarcopenia assessment, but operator dependency limits its standardization. Artificial intelligence (AI) may help automate and improve ultrasound-based muscle evaluation. This scoping review aims to map the current landscape of AI-assisted ultrasound for sarcopenia assessment, including research trends, methods, clinical uses and performance, and to suggest future work. Following Joanna Briggs Institute guidelines and the PRISMA-ScR checklist, we searched PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, the Cochrane Library, CINAHL, ProQuest, CNKI, WanFang Data, Yiigle, VIP, and Sinomed up to July 25, 2026. Two researchers independently selected studies and extracted data. Thirty studies were included. This field is developing rapidly, with 76.7% of studies published in the last 3 years, primarily from Spain and China. Model development and validation studies (43.3%) were most common. U-Net and its variants were the predominant AI architectures, mainly for image segmentation. B-mode ultrasound with high-frequency linear probes was frequently used. The rectus femoris was the most assessed muscle for sarcopenia (73.3%). AI-integrated models for sarcopenia diagnosis achieved AUCs of 0.640-0.950. Reported Dice coefficients for muscle segmentation ranged from 0.73 to 0.99. In-house datasets were used in 66.7% of the studies, and global classification labels were the most frequent annotation strategy (46.7%). AI-assisted ultrasound shows potential for objective and scalable sarcopenia assessment but remains early-stage. Operator dependency in image acquisition has not been fully resolved. Further investigation should determine the added value of integrating multimodal imaging, combining diverse AI techniques, and evaluating multiple muscle groups. Future efforts should deepen image-processing strategies to extract clinically relevant features and facilitate standardized, scalable implementation in clinical practice.
zh_abstract: [Journal of the American Geriatrics Society] 肌肉超声为肌少症评估提供了一种便携、无创且经济有效的选择，但操作者依赖性限制了其标准化。人工智能（AI）可能有助于自动化和改进基于超声的肌肉评估。本范围综述旨在描绘AI辅助超声用于肌少症评估的当前图景，包括研究趋势、方法、临床用途和性能，并提出未来工作建议。遵循Joanna Briggs Institute指南和PRISMA-ScR清单，我们检索了PubMed、Embase、Web of Science、Cochrane Library、CINAHL、ProQuest、CNKI、万方数据、Yiigle、维普和Sinomed，截止日期为2026年7月25日。两名研究者独立筛选研究并提取数据。共纳入30项研究。该领域发展迅速，76.7%的研究发表于过去3年，主要来自西班牙和中国。模型开发与验证研究（43.3%）最常见。U-Net及其变体是主要AI架构，主要用于图像分割。B型超声配合高频线阵探头使用频繁。股直肌是肌少症评估中最常评估的肌肉（73.3%）。用于肌少症诊断的AI整合模型达到AUC 0.640-0.950。报告的肌肉分割Dice系数范围为0.73至0.99。66.7%的研究使用内部数据集，全局分类标签是最常见的标注策略（46.7%）。AI辅助超声在客观且可扩展的肌少症评估方面显示出潜力，但仍处于早期阶段。图像采集中的操作者依赖性尚未完全解决。进一步研究应确定整合多模态成像、结合多种AI技术以及评估多个肌肉群的附加价值。未来工作应深化图像处理策略以提取临床相关特征，并促进临床实践中的标准化、可扩展实施。

abstract: [Cancers] Accurate subtyping of lymphomas is critical for guiding treatment decisions and predicting patient outcomes, yet it remains challenging due to overlapping morphological features. This study aimed to develop and validate a deep learning-based diagnostic system, designated BH-LymphDS, to accurately differentiate the three most prevalent lymphoma subtypes: Diffuse Large B-cell Lymphoma (DLBCL), Follicular Lymphoma (FL), and Hodgkin Lymphoma (HL). The system integrates a Swin Transformer backbone with a clustering-constrained attention multiple instance learning (CLAM) algorithm and a k-nearest neighbors (KNN) classifier, supporting weakly supervised learning directly from whole-slide images without manual region-level annotation. A total of 1910 whole-slide images (WSIs) from diagnostic biopsies were utilized for model development-the largest cohort to date in this field. The performance of nine distinct deep learning architectures was systematically compared. Model efficacy was rigorously evaluated through five-fold cross-validation and further validated on independent external datasets from TCIA and TCGA. Additionally, a comparative analysis was conducted against the diagnostic performance of three experienced hematopathologists. In the internal testing cohort, BH-LymphDS achieved a micro-average AUC of 0.955 and an accuracy of 92.5%. During cross-validation, the system attained a superior micro-average F1-score (0.871) compared to the average of the three hematopathologists (0.851). The Swin Transformer emerged as the optimal backbone, and gradient-weighted class activation mapping (GradCAM) confirmed that the model's decisions were based on legitimate morphological features such as nuclear atypia and cellular growth patterns. Our findings demonstrate that an advanced AI system can satisfy the rigorous requirements for accurate lymphoma subclassification on histopathological slides. The BH-LymphDS shows strong potential as a reliable auxiliary diagnostic tool to enhance clinical workflow efficiency and diagnostic consistency.
zh_abstract: [Cancers] 淋巴瘤的准确亚型分型对于指导治疗决策和预测患者结局至关重要，但由于形态学特征重叠，这仍具有挑战性。本研究旨在开发和验证一种名为BH-LymphDS的基于深度学习的诊断系统，以准确区分三种最常见的淋巴瘤亚型：弥漫性大B细胞淋巴瘤（Diffuse Large B-cell Lymphoma, DLBCL）、滤泡性淋巴瘤（Follicular Lymphoma, FL）和霍奇金淋巴瘤（Hodgkin Lymphoma, HL）。该系统将Swin Transformer主干与聚类约束注意力多实例学习（clustering-constrained attention multiple instance learning, CLAM）算法及k近邻（k-nearest neighbors, KNN）分类器集成，支持直接基于全切片图像进行弱监督学习，无需人工区域级标注。共使用来自诊断性活检的1910张全切片图像（whole-slide images, WSIs）进行模型开发——这是该领域迄今最大的队列。系统比较了九种不同深度学习架构的性能。通过五折交叉验证严格评估模型效能，并在来自TCIA和TCGA的独立外部数据集上进一步验证。此外，还与三名经验丰富的血液病理学家的诊断性能进行了比较分析。在内部测试队列中，BH-LymphDS达到微平均AUC 0.955和准确率92.5%。在交叉验证期间，该系统获得优于三名血液病理学家平均值（0.851）的微平均F1分数（0.871）。Swin Transformer成为最佳主干，梯度加权类激活映射（gradient-weighted class activation mapping, GradCAM）证实模型的决策基于合理的形态学特征，如核异型性和细胞生长模式。我们的发现表明，先进的人工智能系统能够满足在组织病理学切片上准确进行淋巴瘤亚型分类的严格要求。BH-LymphDS显示出作为可靠辅助诊断工具的强大潜力，可提高临床工作流程效率和诊断一致性。

abstract: Deep learning has driven rapid progress in medical image analysis, with methods for tasks such as organ segmentation, anomaly detection, and radiology report generation now matching or surpassing expert performance on several benchmarks. While many methods are released as open source, their routine adoption by clinicians and medical researchers remains limited. The bottleneck is not a lack of capable tools, but the absence of infrastructure to make them accessible to non-technical users. To break this barrier, we present MedMCP, an agentic framework that solves this last-mile problem along two axes: (1) a local agentic workspace that lets users apply state-of-the-art image analysis methods through natural language, and (2) a community-driven tool ecosystem that lets developers deploy and distribute capabilities as validated, independently testable servers. MedMCP enforces a strict orchestration-execution boundary in which a local language model translates user intent into workflow plans, while all image analysis is delegated to domain-specific tools. The framework runs entirely on-premise, every side-effecting operation passes through a human-in-the-loop permission gate, and a full provenance trail links each output to the tools, parameters, and inputs that produced it. An inspectable workspace lets users verify intermediate results rather than blindly trusting the agent, and completed sessions distill into deterministic, shareable workflows that re-execute without the agent, turning one-off interactions into reproducible analyses. This paper introduces the project's general idea and describes the design principles that guide its development. Beyond a single toolkit, we envision MedMCP as a community-driven platform where each contributed tool becomes easily accessible, compounding individual efforts into shared capability.
zh_abstract: 深度学习推动了医学图像分析的快速进展，用于器官分割、异常检测和放射学报告生成等任务的方法，如今在若干基准测试中已达到或超过专家表现。尽管许多方法以开源形式发布，但临床医生和医学研究人员对其常规采用仍然有限。瓶颈并非缺乏有能力工具，而是缺乏使非技术用户能够使用这些工具的基础设施。为打破这一障碍，我们提出 MedMCP，一个智能体框架（agentic framework），从两个维度解决这“最后一公里”问题：（1）本地智能体工作区，让用户通过自然语言应用最先进的图像分析方法；（2）社区驱动的工具生态系统，让开发者将能力作为经过验证、可独立测试的服务器进行部署和分发。MedMCP 强制执行严格的编排—执行边界，其中本地语言模型将用户意图转化为工作流计划，而所有图像分析均委托给领域特定工具。该框架完全在本地部署（on-premise）运行，每个具有副作用的操作都经过人在环路权限门控，并且完整的溯源记录将每项输出与其生成所用的工具、参数和输入关联起来。可检查的工作区让用户验证中间结果，而不是盲目信任智能体；完成的会话可提炼为确定性的、可共享的工作流，无需智能体即可重新执行，从而将一次性交互转化为可重复的分析。本文介绍该项目的总体构想，并描述指导其开发的设计原则。我们设想 MedMCP 不仅是一个单一工具包，而是一个社区驱动的平台，其中每个贡献的工具都可被轻松访问，将个体努力汇聚为共享能力。

title: Comorbidities of dementia in electronic health records: validation of a natural language processing app and comparison with data linkage
zh_title: 痴呆共病NLP工具验证及与数据链接比较
summary: 在3543名痴呆患者中验证MedCAT共病NLP工具，并用链接的初级保健与住院数据做外部效度检验。
key_points: 基于CRIS精神健康病历自由文本抽取共病
以链接的初级保健与住院结构化数据外部验证
比较共病指标对死亡风险的预测价值
reason: 有人工复核内部效度加链接数据外部验证，样本数千，仍为预印本
abstract: Awareness of comorbidities in people with dementia is vital context for dementia research and clinical management. Natural Language Processing (NLP) applied to free text in the electronic health record (EHR) may help ascertain comorbidity presence. Our aim was to assess the validity of the MedCAT Comorbidity NLP app in a cohort of people with dementia. We used text from the EHR of South London and Maudsley NHS Mental Health Trust via Clinical Records Interactive Search (CRIS), linked to structured data from local primary care (Lambeth DataNet) and hospital admission data in a cohort of 3,543 people with dementia. We evaluated MedCAT Comorbidity, examining internal validity via manual review of text and external validity by cross-validation against linked primary care and hospital data; and comparison of the predictive value of comorbidity measures for mortality. Internal precision was highest for atrial fibrillation (100%) and lowest for diabetes (78%). Cross-validation with linked data varied substantially across conditions, with precision from 96% to 59% and recall 77% to 4%. The median number of comorbidities identified was two using any single source, or three when combined. MedCAT Comorbidity demonstrated predictive ability for mortality (HR 1.11 per condition), although the model fit was better using comorbidity from hospital admission data. In people with dementia, the MedCAT Comorbidity app showed high precision for most conditions during internal validation. The variability of precision and recall on external validity assessment partly reflects incomplete documentation. Results from the MedCAT comorbidity app can assist researchers in understanding comorbidity of cohorts, particularly when primary care or hospital data is not available. Our findings highlight the need to develop quality assurance protocols that include internal and external validity checks before deploying general data extraction apps for specific clinical subpopulations.
zh_abstract: 痴呆患者的共病知晓情况是痴呆研究和临床管理的重要背景。将自然语言处理（NLP）应用于电子健康记录（EHR）中的自由文本可能有助于确定共病的存在。我们的目标是在一个痴呆患者队列中评估 MedCAT Comorbidity NLP 应用程序的有效性。我们通过临床记录交互式搜索（CRIS）使用了 South London and Maudsley NHS Mental Health Trust 的 EHR 文本，并将其与来自当地初级保健（Lambeth DataNet）的结构化数据以及医院入院数据在一个由 3,543 名痴呆患者组成的队列中进行了关联。我们评估了 MedCAT Comorbidity，通过对文本进行人工审查来检查内部有效性，并通过与关联的初级保健和医院数据进行交叉验证来检查外部有效性；并比较共病指标对死亡率的预测价值。内部精确度最高的是心房颤动（100%），最低的是糖尿病（78%）。与关联数据的交叉验证在不同疾病之间差异很大，精确度从 96% 到 59%，召回率从 77% 到 4%。使用任何单一来源识别出的共病数量中位数为两个，而合并来源时为三个。MedCAT Comorbidity 显示出对死亡率的预测能力（每种疾病 HR 1.11），尽管使用医院入院数据中的共病时模型拟合更好。在痴呆患者中，MedCAT Comorbidity 应用程序在内部验证期间对大多数疾病显示出高精确度。外部有效性评估中精确度和召回率的变异性部分反映了记录不完整。MedCAT 共病应用程序的结果可以帮助研究人员了解队列的共病情况，尤其是在初级保健或医院数据不可用时。我们的发现强调需要制定质量保证方案，在将通用数据提取应用程序部署到特定临床亚人群之前，应包括内部和外部有效性检查。

title: TiSAM: fusing spatial and histopathology foundation models for whole-slide image segmentation
zh_title: TiSAM：融合空间与病理基础模型分割全切片
summary: TiSAM融合SAM3空间特征与UNI2-h病理特征做全切片语义分割，并公开含52类组织的MegaMouse数据集。
key_points: 多尺度解码器融合空间与病理基础模型特征
发布MegaMouse：12器官52类共3.68万标注
四个公开数据集上优于CNN与ViT模型
reason: 多数据集对比并公开较新病理数据集，但为预印本方法类工作
abstract: Semantic segmentation of whole-slide images (WSIs) quantifies tissue composition and architecture, but existing models require extensive annotation and lose accuracy as the number of tissue classes increases or on heterogeneous, cross-scanner datasets. Here, we present the Tissue Segment Anything Model (TiSAM), which fuses SAM3 spatial features with UNI2-h pathology features within a multi-scale decoder. Because public benchmarks contain few tissue classes, we release MegaMouse, comprising 36,833 annotations of 52 tissue classes from 12 mouse organs, and an 11-class human pancreas dataset. TiSAM achieved the highest overall performance across four public datasets compared to existing convolutional neural network and vision transformer models, maintained high accuracy on MegaMouse, and maintained high accuracy in the human pancreas dataset when trained on as few as 5 annotated WSIs where previous integrations of SAM with pathology foundation models did not. TiSAM segmentations were also more consistent across eight slide scanners compared to other models. These results establish TiSAM as a general and highly adaptable framework for tissue segmentation, enabling studies containing many tissue classes, limited annotations, or images from multiple scanners.
zh_abstract: 全切片图像（WSI）的语义分割可量化组织组成和结构，但现有模型需要大量注释，并且当组织类别数量增加或在异质性、跨扫描仪数据集上时准确性会下降。在此，我们提出组织分割一切模型（TiSAM），它在多尺度解码器内将 SAM3 空间特征与 UNI2-h 病理学特征融合。由于公共基准包含的组织类别很少，我们发布了 MegaMouse，其包含来自 12 个小鼠器官的 52 个组织类别的 36,833 个注释，以及一个 11 类的人类胰腺数据集。与现有卷积神经网络和视觉 Transformer 模型相比，TiSAM 在四个公共数据集上取得了最高的总体性能，在 MegaMouse 上保持了高准确性，并且在仅使用 5 张带注释的 WSI 训练时在人类胰腺数据集上仍保持高准确性，而此前 SAM 与病理学基础模型的整合未能做到这一点。与其他模型相比，TiSAM 的分割结果在八台切片扫描仪之间也更为一致。这些结果确立了 TiSAM 作为一个通用且高度可适应的组织分割框架，使包含许多组织类别、有限注释或来自多台扫描仪图像的研究成为可能。

title: The One-Pixel of Reasoning: One Truthful Relation Is Enough to Mislead LLM Agents
zh_title: 单关系攻击即可误导LLM智能体推理
summary: 预印本提出单关系攻击，用一句有出处的话翻转生物医学推理等任务中智能体的正确答案。
key_points: 18个模型上最佳10次攻击翻转率54.9%/80.0%
攻击可迁移且能绕过来源支持检查
多智能体辩论使团队错误率由50%升至59%
reason: 新攻击方法在18模型含生物医学推理验证，但为预印本无外部临床验证
abstract: Can one sentence manipulate an agent's belief by targeting a single implicit warrant linking evidence to a conclusion? In this paper, we introduce the one-relation attack (ORA), a novel cognitive attack on this inferential relation. ORA localizes a critical implicit warrant and performs a one-relation intervention using a single source-grounded sentence that qualifies this warrant and steers the agent toward an incorrect belief. Across eighteen models on biomedical inference and vulnerability detection, best-of-$10 attacks overturn initially correct answers at mean rates of 54.9% for proprietary and 80.0% for open-weight models. Attacks also transfer without victim feedback, and paired controls support the roles of targeting and qualification. Moreover, successful sentences can pass source-support checks and evade identification, and multi-agent debate raises team error from 50.0% to 59.5% in our balanced stress test. These findings establish implicit warrants as a cognitive attack surface for manipulating agents' beliefs.
zh_abstract: 一句话能否通过针对连接证据与结论的单个隐含授权（implicit warrant）来操纵智能体的信念？在本文中，我们引入单关系攻击（one-relation attack，ORA），一种针对该推断关系的新型认知攻击。ORA 定位关键的隐含授权，并使用一个基于来源的句子执行单关系干预，该句子限定这一授权并将智能体引向错误信念。在生物医学推断和漏洞检测的十八个模型上，best-of-$10 攻击使最初正确答案被推翻的平均比率在专有模型上为 54.9%，在开放权重模型上为 80.0%。攻击还可在没有受害者反馈的情况下迁移，配对对照支持定位和限定的作用。此外，成功句子能够通过来源支持检查并逃避识别，而在我们的平衡压力测试中，多智能体辩论将团队错误率从 50.0% 提高到 59.5%。这些发现确立隐含授权作为操纵智能体信念的认知攻击面。

title: TCMScience: An Autonomous Scientist for Traditional Chinese Medicine
zh_title: TCMScience：面向中医药的自主科研智能体
summary: arXiv预印本提出TCMScience，将语言模型提案与执行、发布权限分离，并核验结论的来源与证据范围。
key_points: 117个公开源连接器、444个类型化操作
150个原生工具覆盖12个领域
主张对结论做来源与研究设计核验
reason: 预印本新方法加大规模工具注册表，缺外部验证，值得一看档
abstract: Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) research connects classical texts, medicinal entities, molecular assays, computational predictions, and clinical studies. An autonomous research agent must preserve the inferential boundaries between these evidence types while coordinating analysis across heterogeneous resources. We introduce TCMScience, a scientific knowledge-discovery agent that separates language-model proposals from execution and release authority. Its architecture combines a trusted kernel, a scientific compiler, and claim-support contracts: plans are compiled into typed operations, execution is bounded by explicit permissions, and candidate findings are checked against source provenance, study design, and claim scope before release. The full capability registry contains 117 public-source connectors with 444 typed operations across 29 domains and 150 native tools across 12 domains; the TCM data hub catalogs 136 databases, 76 dataset specifications, and 84,294 formula-source records. These resources support model-independent workflows through browser and local execution interfaces. In a network-pharmacology analysis of Gegen Qinlian Tang, replacing the whole-proteome background with the assayed-protein background changed the number of significant pathways from 66 to zero; incorporating inactive screening records identified nine pathways, including drug-metabolism signals retained as mechanistic hypotheses. A governance ablation over 121 constructed erroneous outputs spanning 26 classes released 121 errors without governance, 57 with the domain layer, seven with the kernel, and zero with both layers. All 10 compliant controls were retained. These results establish complementary control of known failure modes and show how explicit evidence contracts change the conclusions an agent is permitted to report.
zh_abstract: 中医药（TCM）研究连接经典文本、药物实体、分子实验、计算预测和临床研究。自主研究智能体必须在协调异构资源分析的同时，保留这些证据类型之间的推断边界。我们介绍TCMScience，一种科学知识发现智能体，它将语言模型提议与执行和发布权限分离。其架构结合可信内核、科学编译器和论断支持契约：计划被编译为类型化操作，执行受显式权限约束，候选发现在发布前依据来源溯源、研究设计和论断范围进行核查。完整能力注册表包含117个公共来源连接器，具有跨29个领域的444个类型化操作，以及跨12个领域的150个原生工具；中医药数据中枢编目136个数据库、76个数据集规范和84,294条方剂来源记录。这些资源通过浏览器和本地执行接口支持模型无关的工作流。在对葛根芩连汤（Gegen Qinlian Tang）的网络药理学分析中，将全蛋白质组背景替换为已检测蛋白背景后，显著通路的数量从66变为零；纳入非活性筛选记录后识别出九条通路，包括保留为机制假说的药物代谢信号。一项治理消融实验跨越26类、包含121个构造错误输出，在无治理下释放121个错误，有领域层时释放57个，有内核时释放七个，两层都有时为零。所有10个合规对照均被保留。这些结果确立了对已知失效模式的互补控制，并表明显式证据契约如何改变智能体被允许报告的结论。

title: AI-Driven Reproducibility and Analytical Robustness in Scientific Discovery
zh_title: LLM智能体自动复现SEER研究并检验稳健性
summary: 预印本构建SEER-Repro基准与LLM智能体，复现20篇SEER论文中77.4%的原子论断并测试结论稳健性。
key_points: SEER-Repro收录20篇已发表SEER研究及复现资源
智能体复现2190条原子论断中的77.4%
另建智能体流程识别分析选择以检验稳健性
reason: 新基准加智能体流程，方法清晰但为预印本、证据有限
abstract: Reproducible and analytically robust research findings are essential to scientific progress, but evaluating these properties typically requires costly manual effort. We investigate whether LLM agents can help automate reproduction and robustness analysis, using a medical case study grounded in the Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results (SEER) database, a widely used U.S. cancer registry underlying tens of thousands of published studies. First, we introduce SEER-Repro, a benchmark of 20 published SEER-based papers together with the data and resources required to reproduce their findings. Second, we create an AI agent that successfully reproduces 77.4% of 2,190 atomic claims, while providing executable baselines for further analysis. Third, we develop an agentic analysis pipeline to test the robustness of the medical findings by identifying analytical choices underlying each finding, proposing defensible alternatives, and rerunning the analysis to determine whether those choices affect the conclusion. Across published papers in SEER-Repro, our pipeline identifies potentially consequential analytical choices in 9.5% of fully reproduced findings and flags them for expert review. These results show how LLM agents can support scientific review by reproducing findings, systematically testing their robustness, and directing expert attention toward potentially consequential analytical choices.
zh_abstract: 可复现且分析稳健的研究发现对科学进步至关重要，但评估这些属性通常需要昂贵的人工投入。我们研究大语言模型智能体（LLM agents）能否帮助自动化复现和稳健性分析，采用一个基于监测、流行病学和最终结果（Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results, SEER）数据库的医学案例研究；该数据库是美国广泛使用的癌症登记数据库，支撑了数万项已发表研究。首先，我们引入SEER-Repro，这是一个包含20篇已发表的基于SEER的论文以及复现其发现所需数据和资源的基准。其次，我们创建一个AI智能体，成功复现了2,190条原子主张中的77.4%，同时为进一步分析提供可执行基线。第三，我们开发一个智能体分析流程，通过识别每项发现背后的分析选择、提出有合理依据的替代选择，并重新运行分析以确定这些选择是否影响结论，来检验医学发现的稳健性。在SEER-Repro的已发表论文中，我们的流程在9.5%的完全复现发现中识别出可能影响结论的分析选择，并将其标记供专家审查。这些结果表明，LLM智能体如何通过复现发现、系统检验其稳健性，并引导专家关注可能影响结论的分析选择，来支持科学审查。

title: Transport What Shares the Conduction Pathway: Normal-Anchored SPD Geometric Transport for Source-Free Patient Adaptation of Holter and Patch ECG
zh_title: 面向Holter与贴片心电的无源患者自适应几何传输
summary: 预印本提出NAGT方法，用记录前5分钟正常搏动锚点做无源域适应，按预注册方案在Icentia11k上单次评估心搏分类。
key_points: 以正常搏动为锚点估计SPD同余映射并固定室性与融合原型
冻结模型在Icentia11k贴片心电上预注册单次评估
评估覆盖493例患者、973段记录、361万余心搏
reason: 预注册评估与大规模外部数据，但为预印本且无临床结局
abstract: Electrocardiogram (ECG) beat classifiers lose accuracy on new patients and devices, and source-free adaptation methods that assume class-balanced target batches fail on real recordings, whose label-free prefix is 87.9--98.6% normal beats. We propose Normal-Anchored Geometric Transport (NAGT, GA_NS), which estimates a closed-form symmetric positive-definite congruence map from label-free normal anchors in the first 5 min of each recording and applies it only to the normal and supraventricular prototypes, keeping the ventricular and fusion prototypes fixed. The score offsets and decision rules were set on MIT-BIH only; the rate-invariant RR head (relA) was adopted after the development databases (INCART, SVDB) had been opened; the frozen model was then evaluated once on Icentia11k chest-patch recordings under a pre-registered protocol. In 493 patients (973 recordings, 3,615,388 evaluated beats), NAGT reached an arrhythmia macro-$F_1$ $J = \frac{1}{2}(\text{S-}F_1 + \text{V-}F_1) = 48.7\%$ [95% CI 42.1, 54.7] versus 34.5% without adaptation ($ΔJ = +14.1$ [+8.6, +19.3] pp; 59.8% versus 43.9% in non-AF) and outperformed all five Holm-adjusted comparators, including AdaBN, Tent and T3A. In the 75-patient test subgroup of the historical split (73 analyzed), the gain was not significant (+6.1 [-8.5, +23.4] pp). Adaptation takes a median of 5.8 ms per record without back-propagation.
zh_abstract: 心电图（ECG）心搏分类器在新患者和新设备上会损失准确性，而假设目标批次类别平衡的无源适配方法在真实记录上会失败，因为这些记录的无标签前缀中 87.9--98.6% 为正常心搏。我们提出 Normal-Anchored Geometric Transport（NAGT，GA_NS），它从每条记录前 5 分钟的无标签正常锚点估计闭式对称正定同余映射，并仅将其应用于正常和室上性原型，保持室性和融合原型不变。分数偏移和决策规则仅在 MIT-BIH 上设定；率不变的 RR 头（relA）是在开发数据库（INCART、SVDB）开放后采用的；随后在预注册方案下，对冻结模型在 Icentia11k 胸贴记录上评估一次。在 493 名患者（973 条记录，3,615,388 个评估心搏）中，NAGT 达到心律失常宏 $F_1$ $J = \frac{1}{2}(\text{S-}F_1 + \text{V-}F_1) = 48.7\%$ [95% CI 42.1, 54.7]，而未适配时为 34.5%（$ΔJ = +14.1$ [+8.6, +19.3] 个百分点；非 AF 中为 59.8% 对 43.9%），并优于所有五个 Holm 校正比较器，包括 AdaBN、Tent 和 T3A。在历史划分的 75 名患者测试亚组中（分析 73 名），增益不显著（+6.1 [-8.5, +23.4] 个百分点）。适配无需反向传播，每条记录的中位耗时为 5.8 ms。

title: NV-Generate-Body: 3D Latent Diffusion Model forControllable Anatomy, Tumor, and Demographic Body Mask Synthesis
zh_title: 3D潜扩散模型合成全身CT解剖与肿瘤掩膜
summary: 提出3D潜扩散模型，按器官形态、肿瘤负荷与人口学条件生成全身CT分割掩膜。
key_points: 基于冻结掩膜自编码器潜空间生成256³标签图
8,571例掩膜、26个队列、132个标签训练
器官大小Spearman 0.70–0.92，部分肿瘤召回85–100%
reason: 预印本生成方法，数据规模较大且指标量化，未做下游外部验证
abstract: Curating large labeled CT datasets is expensive and constrained by patient privacy. We present NV-Generate-BodyMask, a 3D latent diffusion model that synthesizes whole-body CT segmentation masks with precise, joint control over organ anatomy, tumor burden, and patient demographics. The model operates in the compressed latent space of a frozen mask autoencoder, generating $256^3$ volumetric label maps conditioned on a 19-dimensional vector via Adaptive Group Normalization and cross-attention. A size-adaptive ROI loss with spatial halo weighting and a paired tumor injection pipeline enable accurate tumor size conditioning despite the scarcity of annotated tumor cases. Trained on 8,571 masks across 26 cohorts spanning 132 labels, the model achieves Spearman $ρ= 0.70$--$0.92$ for organ size, 85--100\% tumor recall for lung, pancreatic, colon, and bone lesions, and strong demographic alignment (BMI $ρ= 0.78$, sex-conditioned perfect prostate control).
zh_abstract: 整理大型标注CT数据集成本高昂且受患者隐私限制。我们提出NV-Generate-BodyMask，一种三维潜在扩散模型，可合成全身CT分割掩膜，并对器官解剖、肿瘤负荷和患者人口学特征进行精确联合控制。该模型在冻结掩膜自编码器的压缩潜在空间中运行，通过自适应组归一化（Adaptive Group Normalization）和交叉注意力，以19维向量为条件生成$256^3$体数据标签图。带空间光晕加权的大小自适应ROI损失和配对肿瘤注入流程，使得在标注肿瘤病例稀缺的情况下仍能实现准确的肿瘤大小条件控制。该模型在跨26个队列、涵盖132个标签的8,571个掩膜上训练，器官大小的Spearman $ρ= 0.70$–$0.92$，肺部、胰腺、结肠和骨病灶的肿瘤召回率为85–100%，并具有强人口学对齐（BMI $ρ= 0.78$，性别条件下完美前列腺控制）。

title: Recognizing Study Lineage Is Not Enough: Over-Crediting Same-Trial Evidence in LLM-Based Medical Verification
zh_title: 医学LLM核查中同一试验证据被过度采信
summary: 发现模型能识别同一试验来源，但在证据聚合时仍重复计入同一试验的多篇报告。
key_points: 14个来源核查临床族、5种模型条件
识别任务10/10正确但聚合任务5/5过度采信
加入研究分组指令可部分缓解
reason: 揭示LLM证据聚合的系统性偏差，设计较严谨，但为预印本小规模评测
abstract: Publication count is not study count. A model can identify shared trial lineage correctly in a direct task yet over-credit a second publication from the same trial when aggregating evidence. We evaluate this behavior in medical LLM verification using 14 source-audited clinical families and five model conditions. The families span provenance, clinical applicability, result direction, and composition; the provenance families provide the direct lineage tests. Recognition and aggregation are separate stateless calls, and repeated calls assess within-input stability. Across all three original provenance families, GPT-5.5 identifies the independent update in 10/10 recognition calls per family but over-credits the same-trial report in 5/5 separate aggregation calls per family. Selected Qwen3-4B and Ministral-3-8B conditions show the same cross-task contrast. A study-grouping instruction reduces GPT-5.5 over-credit from 4/5 to 0/5 in each later pure-provenance family. Other model conditions show mixed behavior, and rejected outputs limit several comparisons. The results identify a behavioral gap between elicited lineage recognition and evidence aggregation. The code and data artifacts are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/study-lineage-review-artifact.
zh_abstract: 发表数量不等于研究数量。模型可以在直接任务中正确识别共享试验谱系，但在汇总证据时对同一试验的第二篇发表过度计分。我们使用14个经来源审计的临床家族和五种模型条件，在医学LLM验证中评估这一行为。这些家族涵盖来源、临床适用性、结果方向和构成；来源家族提供直接的谱系测试。识别和汇总是分离的无状态调用，重复调用评估输入内稳定性。在所有三个原始来源家族中，GPT-5.5在每个家族的识别调用中以10/10识别出独立更新，但在每个家族5/5的单独汇总调用中对同一试验报告过度计分。选定的Qwen3-4B和Ministral-3-8B条件显示相同的跨任务对比。研究分组指令将GPT-5.5在每个后续纯来源家族中的过度计分从4/5降低到0/5。其他模型条件显示混合行为，被拒绝的输出限制了一些比较。结果识别出所引发的谱系识别与证据汇总之间的行为差距。代码和数据工件可在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/study-lineage-review-artifact获取。

title: GliomaINK: A Tumor and Anatomy Conditioned Flow Matching Framework for 3D MRI Sequence Synthesis in Glioma Patients
zh_title: GliomaINK：肿瘤与解剖条件化MRI序列合成
summary: 预印本提出解剖引导的条件流匹配框架，用于胶质瘤患者缺失3D MRI序列的跨序列合成。
key_points: 训练1083例BraTS-AG，另用院内独立队列测试

abstract: Background: Incomplete multiparametric MR examinations limit glioma characterization and downstream AI tools. Generative models can synthesize missing MRI sequences, but anatomical structure and clinically relevant tumor features are challenging to preserve. We propose GliomaINK, an anatomy-guided conditional flow matching framework for cross-sequence 3D brain MRI synthesis. Methods: A 3D SwinUNETR predicted the conditional velocity field while an auxiliary topology-preserving loss encouraged structural consistency. The model was trained on 1,083 patients from the BraTS-AG dataset and independently tested on an in-house clinical cohort. Downstream tasks include image quality, tumor segmentation, IDH1 mutation-status prediction, and overall survival prediction. Two radiologists independently evaluated the anatomical fidelity, pathological representation, and overall image quality of the synthesized images. Results: GliomaINK exhibited the highest PSNR across all six MRI translation directions in both evaluation cohorts. In the BraTS-AG test set, the PSNR reached $25.64\pm0.55$ dB for the T2W-to-T1C synthesis, compared with $13.78\pm0.32$ dB for Pix2Pix and $18.90\pm0.53$ dB for SPADE. For downstream tumor segmentation, the method showed strong performance across tumor subregions with Dice scores reaching $0.928\pm0.014$ for edema, and $0.885\pm0.040$ for enhancing tumor. For the IDH1 mutation-status prediction, GliomaINK achieved the highest AUROC score in four of the six sequence configurations, reaching $0.827\pm0.088$. Conclusion: Anatomy-guided conditional flow matching enables high-fidelity cross-sequence glioma MRI synthesis demonstrating potential for preservation of clinically relevant information in synthesized MRI and improving downstream tasks.
zh_abstract: 【背景】不完整的多参数MR检查限制了胶质瘤表征和下游AI工具。生成模型可以合成缺失的MRI序列，但解剖结构和临床相关肿瘤特征难以保留。我们提出GliomaINK，一种用于跨序列3D脑MRI合成的解剖引导条件流匹配框架。【方法】一个3D SwinUNETR预测条件速度场，同时一个辅助的拓扑保持损失鼓励结构一致性。该模型在来自BraTS-AG数据集的1,083名患者上训练，并在内部临床队列上独立测试。下游任务包括图像质量、肿瘤分割、IDH1突变状态预测和总生存期预测。两名放射科医生独立评估合成图像的解剖保真度、病理表征和整体图像质量。【结果】GliomaINK在两个评估队列的所有六个MRI转换方向中均表现出最高的PSNR。在BraTS-AG测试集中，T2W到T1C合成的PSNR达到25.64±0.55 dB，而Pix2Pix为13.78±0.32 dB，SPADE为18.90±0.53 dB。对于下游肿瘤分割，该方法在肿瘤各亚区表现出强劲性能，水肿的Dice分数达到0.928±0.014，强化肿瘤达到0.885±0.040。对于IDH1突变状态预测，GliomaINK在六个序列配置中的四个中取得了最高的AUROC分数，达到0.827±0.088。【结论】解剖引导条件流匹配能够实现高保真跨序列胶质瘤MRI合成，显示出在合成MRI中保留临床相关信息并改善下游任务的潜力。

title: Benchmarking and Improvement of Artifact Segmentation Methods in H&E-Stained Whole Slide Imaging
zh_title: H&E全切片伪影分割方法的基准评测与改进
summary: 系统比较六种公开伪影分割算法在多中心、多器官H&E全切片上的表现，并发布一个新数据集。

abstract: Technical artifacts introduced during tissue preparation or slide scanning remain a major obstacle to developing robust computational pathology algorithms for hematoxylin and eosin (HE)-stained whole-slide images (WSIs). Despite the growing number of quality-control tools, their real-world utility remains hard to assess because of the limited number of publicly available implementations and the lack of systematic, multi-dataset comparisons. This paper presents a benchmark of artifact segmentation methods for HE-stained WSIs. After a literature review, six publicly available algorithms were selected and compared in terms of their ability to segment artifact-free tissue and selected artifact classes. Two publicly available datasets and a newly introduced dataset released to support further research were used for evaluation. Tissue samples from multiple medical centers and different organs are included, enabling evaluation across heterogeneous data sources. Segmentation performance was assessed using Dice Index, pixel-level recall, and false discovery rate for artifact-free tissue segmentation. For algorithms supporting multiclass artifact segmentation, class-wise Dice Index and inter-class misclassification were evaluated. In addition to segmentation quality, processing time was assessed. Statistical analysis revealed significant differences in segmentation performance between methods. HistoKit, which incorporates a modified version of the GrandQC, was identified as the best-performing algorithm, while HistoQC was the worst. In terms of artifact types, dark spots and out of focus regions were harder to segment than others. Finally, a simple post-processing step was introduced for HistoKit, which further improved segmentation performance. The benchmark establishes a reference for evaluating and developing artifact segmentation methods for HE-stained WSIs.
zh_abstract: 组织制备或切片扫描过程中引入的技术伪影，仍然是开发用于苏木精-伊红（hematoxylin and eosin, HE）染色全切片图像（whole-slide images, WSIs）的稳健计算病理学算法的主要障碍。尽管质量控制工具数量不断增加，但由于公开可用的实现数量有限，且缺乏系统性的多数据集比较，其实际效用仍难以评估。本文提出了一个针对 HE 染色 WSI 的伪影分割方法基准测试。在文献综述后，选择了六种公开可用的算法，并比较它们分割无伪影组织和选定伪影类别的能力。评估使用了两个公开数据集和一个为支持进一步研究而新发布的数据集。数据包括来自多个医疗中心和不同器官的组织样本，从而能够跨异质性数据源进行评估。采用 Dice 指数（Dice Index）、像素级召回率和错误发现率评估无伪影组织分割的分割性能。对于支持多类别伪影分割的算法，评估了各类别 Dice 指数和类间误分类。除分割质量外，还评估了处理时间。统计分析显示，不同方法之间的分割性能存在显著差异。HistoKit 集成了 GrandQC 的修改版本，被确定为性能最佳的算法，而 HistoQC 性能最差。就伪影类型而言，暗斑和失焦区域比其他类型更难分割。最后，为 HistoKit 引入了一个简单的后处理步骤，进一步提高了分割性能。该基准为评估和开发 HE 染色 WSI 的伪影分割方法建立了参考。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Istituto Giannina Gaslini; conditions: Epilepsies; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 2000; status: RECRUITING] This study will test computer programs that help doctors read brain MRI scans. The programs use artificial intelligence (AI). The study includes people with epilepsy, a condition that causes repeated seizures. Brain changes linked to epilepsy can be hard to see on an MRI (magnetic resonance imaging) scan. Different doctors may read the same scan in different ways. The researchers want to build AI tools that help doctors find these changes earlier. Earlier findings could lead to a faster diagnosis. They could also help doctors decide if a genetic test or a brain surgery evaluation is right for a patient. The researchers also want to learn if AI can predict how well epilepsy surgery will work. If it can, surgeons could use the tool to plan an operation. The goal is to stop seizures while protecting parts of the brain that control speech and sight. Who can take part? People with epilepsy who are treated at the Gaslini Institute or another study center Adults who give their own written consent Children whose parent or caregiver gives written consent People who do not agree to take part cannot be included. What will happen? The researchers will collect brain MRI scans from about 2,000 people. The scans come from regular clinical care. The researchers will replace each person's name on the scan with a code number. The coded scans go to a secure online portal. Study centers around the world share this portal. One trained researcher will run the AI programs on the scans. The researchers will keep the scans for 2 years to build an image library. The researchers will compare the scans with health information. They want to find signs in the scans that show how epilepsy may change over time. This study does not test a new medicine or treatment. It will last about 2 years.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：Istituto Giannina Gaslini；疾病：癫痫；类型：观察性；入组人数：2000；状态：招募中] 本研究将测试帮助医生阅读脑部MRI扫描的计算机程序。这些程序使用人工智能（AI）。该研究纳入癫痫患者，这是一种会导致反复癫痫发作的疾病。与癫痫相关的脑部改变在MRI（磁共振成像）扫描上可能难以看到。不同医生可能以不同方式解读同一扫描。研究人员希望构建AI工具，帮助医生更早发现这些改变。更早发现可能带来更快诊断。它们还可能帮助医生判断基因检测或脑外科手术评估是否适合某位患者。研究人员还想了解AI能否预测癫痫手术的效果如何。如果可以，外科医生可使用该工具来规划手术。目标是在保护控制言语和视觉的脑部区域的同时阻止癫痫发作。谁可以参加？在Gaslini研究所或其他研究中心接受治疗的癫痫患者；自行提供书面同意的成人；由其父母或照护者提供书面同意的儿童。不同意参加者不能纳入。将会发生什么？研究人员将收集约2000人的脑部MRI扫描。扫描来自常规临床诊疗。研究人员将用代码编号替换每人的姓名。编码后的扫描进入一个安全的在线门户。世界各地的研究中心共享该门户。一名受过培训的研究人员将在扫描上运行AI程序。研究人员将保留扫描2年，以建立图像库。研究人员将把扫描与健康信息进行比较。他们希望找到扫描中可显示癫痫可能随时间变化的征象。本研究不测试新药或新疗法。研究将持续约2年。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Fujian Cancer Hospital; conditions: Breast Neoplasm Female, Triple -Negative Breast Cancer; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 120; status: RECRUITING] This study is a multicenter, prospective, observational cohort study to evaluate the predictive performance of pre-treatment DCE-MRI-based artificial intelligence (AI) models for neoadjuvant chemotherapy benefit in locally advanced triple-negative breast cancer. The study plans to enroll eligible locally advanced triple-negative breast cancer patients receiving routine standard neoadjuvant chemotherapy and stratify participants into high-benefit and low-benefit subgroups via the established AI model based on baseline breast DCE-MRI images. All enrolled patients will undergo systematic collection of baseline clinical-pathological data, pre-treatment DCE-MRI scans, neoadjuvant chemotherapy regimens, pathological complete response (pCR) status, objective response rate (ORR), and long-term survival endpoints including disease-free survival (DFS) and overall survival (OS). The primary objective compares the pCR rate between AI-defined high-benefit patients and published historical control data; secondary analyses compare ORR, pCR proportion, DFS and OS between AI-stratified high-benefit and low-benefit subgroups to comprehensively verify the clinical value of this imaging AI model for individualized neoadjuvant chemotherapy selection.

abstract: [Journal of obesity] Obesity remains a complex global public health crisis driven by environmental, biochemical, and behavioral factors, leading to severe metabolic comorbidities. Digital therapeutics (DTx) has emerged as a scalable, data-driven intervention, utilizing wearable sensors, mobile applications, and artificial intelligence (AI) to deliver personalized weight-management strategies. Rather than relying solely on traditional approaches, true DTx distinguishes it through rigorous clinical validation and targeted behavioral modification. Current evidence from clinical trials and real-world data indicates that while DTx effectively enhances patient engagement and promotes short-term behavioral change, sustaining long-term adherence and significant weight loss remains a critical challenge. Furthermore, the integration of AI models offers advanced personalization, though their efficacy must be balanced against potential algorithmic biases and traditional statistical approaches. Successful implementation of DTx into standard obesity care requires overcoming substantial barriers, particularly digital divide, data privacy concerns, and fragmented regulatory frameworks. Ultimately, realizing the full potential of DTx necessitates collaborative efforts to establish standardized regulations, ensure equitable access, and design evidence-based interventions that prioritize long-term patient engagement and clinical efficacy.
zh_abstract: [Journal of obesity] 肥胖仍然是一个复杂的全球公共卫生危机，由环境、生化和行为因素驱动，并导致严重的代谢性共病。数字疗法（DTx）已成为一种可扩展、数据驱动的干预措施，利用可穿戴传感器、移动应用和人工智能（AI）来提供个性化体重管理策略。真正的DTx并非仅依赖传统方法，而是通过严格的临床验证和有针对性的行为改变来区别于传统方法。当前来自临床试验和真实世界数据的证据表明，尽管DTx有效增强患者参与并促进短期行为改变，但维持长期依从性和显著减重仍是一项关键挑战。此外，AI模型的整合提供了先进的个性化，但其疗效必须与潜在的算法偏倚和传统统计方法进行平衡。将DTx成功实施到标准肥胖照护中需要克服重大障碍，尤其是数字鸿沟、数据隐私问题和碎片化的监管框架。最终，实现DTx的全部潜力需要协作努力，以建立标准化法规、确保公平可及，并设计优先考虑长期患者参与和临床疗效的循证干预措施。

abstract: [JMIR medical education] Urology education must prepare learners to integrate anatomical visualization, diagnostic reasoning, technical performance, communication, and ethical judgment, often under restricted working hours and limited access to high-fidelity cases. This viewpoint argues that large language models (LLMs) and metaverse-related technologies should be integrated as complementary, supervised educational tools rather than treated as autonomous replacements for educators or clinical experience. LLMs can support cognitive apprenticeship, documentation practice, assessment, and communication simulations, whereas extended reality, cloud computing, and virtual digital humans can support spatial, procedural, and remote learning. Our aim is to articulate 3 key messages: first, the educational value of these technologies depends on alignment with defined urological competencies; second, implementation should proceed in stages from governed data infrastructure to intelligent interaction and immersive multimodal training; and third, educational effectiveness must be established through prospective evaluations of transfer to clinical performance, not through technical novelty alone. We emphasize the need for rigorous randomized controlled trials, identify requirements for haptic and biomechanical fidelity, and discuss hallucination, bias, privacy, accountability, and deskilling. The responsible future of intelligent urology education will therefore require collaboration among learners, educators, clinicians, engineers, ethicists, institutions, and professional bodies.

abstract: [Advanced healthcare materials] The clinical success of immunotherapies is hindered by the absence of robust methodologies for the early and accurate assessment of antitumor immune responses. Integrating engineered biomaterials with artificial intelligence (AI)-driven molecular imaging technology offers a powerful approach for predicting immune efficacy. However, its clinical translation is significantly hindered by several critical limitations, including the complex and costly synthesis of multifunctional imaging probes, insufficient deep-tissue penetration, suboptimal in vivo signal-to-noise ratios, potential immunogenicity and off-target toxicity, and the limited generalizability of deep learning models across heterogeneous patient populations. In view of these pressing scientific challenges, this review focuses on the application of chemical and biomolecular strategies-enhanced engineered biomaterials in promoting the sensitivity and specificity of advanced imaging modalities for visualizing signaling molecules and immune cells in the tumor microenvironment (TME). Meanwhile, recent progress in deep learning-driven image analysis has enabled strong predictive capabilities and automated the understanding of complex immune system dynamics. Together, these technologies provide a transformative platform for non-invasive monitoring, personalized treatment, and response prediction, with the potential to advance precision immuno-oncology and significantly impact both basic research and clinical translation.

abstract: [Public health] This scoping review examined how artificial intelligence is applied in multidisciplinary and cross-sector public health practice, focusing on public health roles, collaborative implementation, and cross-sector governance and equity risks. Scoping review. Following Arksey and O'Malley's framework and PRISMA-ScR reporting guidance, six databases were searched. Sources were included if they examined artificial intelligence or artificial intelligence-enabled decision support in public, population, or community health contexts and provided information on public health functions, collaboration, implementation, equity, or governance. Data were charted and synthesised narratively by study characteristics, artificial intelligence roles, collaborators, implementation conditions, and governance risks. 27 sources published between 2021 and 2026 were included. Most were reviews, evidence syntheses, policy or guidance documents, or conceptual papers, with relatively few empirical or practitioner-oriented studies. Artificial intelligence was mainly used for surveillance and early warning, population risk modelling, health communication, misinformation detection, policy intelligence, participatory co-creation, and routine public health operations. Implementation depended on collaboration among public health practitioners, epidemiologists, data scientists, policymakers, legal and ethics experts, communication specialists, community organisations, and affected populations. Cross-sector governance and equity risks included poor data quality, limited interoperability, workforce gaps, weak real-world evaluation, privacy risks, and unclear accountability. Artificial intelligence applications in public health are expanding, but the evidence base remains heterogeneous and empirically limited. Routine operational support and AI readiness, together with surveillance and early warning, were among the more frequently represented roles, while empirical evidence on real-world implementation, community engagement and governance evaluation remained limited. Future research should move beyond model performance to examine workflow fit, equity impact, public trust, accountability and population-level outcomes.

abstract: [Healthcare (Basel, Switzerland)] Background/Objectives: Acute appendicitis is the most common surgical emergency of childhood, yet its diagnosis remains difficult because presentations are atypical, inflammatory markers are nonspecific, and the consequences of error run in both directions, from negative appendectomy to missed perforation. Over the past two decades, a large body of work has tried to support this decision with clinical scores, and more recently with machine learning, deep learning, and large language models. Methods: This critical methodological review synthesises that literature across the whole care pathway rather than the single question of binary diagnosis, using a reproducible search and a transparent study-level appraisal, and it therefore covers severity stratification, prediction of non-operative treatment response, imaging stewardship, and the postoperative course. We evaluate this evidence through the lens of contemporary methodological standards, in particular the Transparent Reporting of a multivariable prediction model for Individual Prognosis Or Diagnosis, updated for artificial intelligence (TRIPOD+AI), and the Prediction model Risk Of Bias Assessment Tool, updated for artificial intelligence (PROBAST+AI). Results: We describe the main families of models, from the Alvarado and Pediatric Appendicitis scores to random forests, gradient boosting, convolutional networks applied to ultrasound, and emerging generative models. Reported performance is dominated by discrimination while calibration, clinical utility, external validation, fairness, and reproducibility are reported inconsistently and are often absent. We argue that the recurring pattern of very high reported accuracy reflects methodological fragility more than clinical readiness. Conclusions: We offer a practical checklist for the critical appraisal of appendicitis prediction studies together with a research agenda aimed at closing the gap between a high area under the curve and safe use at the bedside.
zh_abstract: [Healthcare (Basel, Switzerland)] 【背景/目的】急性阑尾炎是儿童期最常见的外科急症，但其诊断仍然困难，因为表现不典型、炎症标志物缺乏特异性，而且错误的后果是双向的，从阴性阑尾切除到漏诊穿孔。过去二十年，大量研究试图用临床评分支持这一决策，最近则用机器学习、深度学习和大型语言模型。【方法】本批判性方法学综述综合了整个照护路径上的该文献，而不仅仅是二分类诊断这一单一问题；采用可重复的检索和透明的基于研究的评估，因此涵盖严重程度分层、非手术治疗反应预测、影像学管理以及术后病程。我们通过当代方法学标准的视角评估这些证据，尤其是针对个体预后或诊断的多变量预测模型的透明报告，已针对人工智能更新（TRIPOD+AI），以及预测模型偏倚风险评估工具，已针对人工智能更新（PROBAST+AI）。【结果】我们描述主要模型家族，从Alvarado评分和儿童阑尾炎评分到随机森林、梯度提升、应用于超声的卷积网络以及新兴生成模型。报告的性能以判别度为主，而校准、临床效用、外部验证、公平性和可重复性报告不一致且常常缺失。我们认为，报告准确率极高的反复出现模式更多反映方法学脆弱性，而非临床就绪。【结论】我们提供一份用于批判性评价阑尾炎预测研究的实用清单，以及一项研究议程，旨在缩小高曲线下面积与床旁安全使用之间的差距。

abstract: Objective: To determine how cohort versus nested case-control (NCC) design affects EHR-based prediction of a rare outcome. Materials and Methods: We compared two cohort and five NCC designs for predicting early-onset gastrointestinal cancer using L1-regularized logistic regression (LASSO), XGBoost, and multilayer perceptron (MLP). Models underwent nested five-fold cross-validation with model-specific hyperparameter tuning and temporal evaluation in a held-out prospective cohort representing intended deployment. Model discrimination was assessed using area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) and area under the precision-recall curve (AUPRC). Model calibration was assessed using Brier scores and calibration plots before and after recalibration with isotonic regression. Feature-ranking similarity was quantified using rank-biased overlap. Results: The cohort development datasets included 256,854-415,529 patients, with 2-yr cumulative incidence of 0.12%-0.17%, compared with approximately 9% in the 1:10 matched NCC datasets. NCC designs generally produced higher internal discrimination, but temporal performance varied by algorithm and index-date definition. Cohort designs achieved the highest temporal AUPRC for LASSO (0.068), whereas diagnosis-anchored NCC achieved the highest temporal AUPRC for XGBoost (0.086) and MLP (0.070). Temporal AUPRC generally decreased as the required lead time before diagnosis increased. Raw predicted probabilities substantially overestimated observed risks in the temporal cohort. Isotonic recalibration improved probability scaling while largely preserving discrimination, although residual miscalibration remained. Cohort-based feature rankings were more consistent across algorithms, whereas NCC-based rankings depended more strongly on algorithm and index-date anchoring. Conclusion: Study design should be selected and evaluated according to the intended clinical prediction task and deployment setting.
zh_abstract: 【目的】确定队列设计与巢式病例对照（NCC）设计如何影响基于EHR的罕见结局预测。【材料与方法】我们比较了两种队列设计和五种NCC设计，使用L1正则化逻辑回归（LASSO）、XGBoost和多层感知机（MLP）预测早发性胃肠道癌症。模型接受嵌套五折交叉验证，并进行模型特定超参数调优，并在代表预期部署的留出前瞻性队列中进行时间评估。模型区分度使用受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）和精确率-召回率曲线下面积（AUPRC）评估。模型校准在等渗回归重校准前后使用Brier评分和校准图评估。特征排序相似性使用排名偏倚重叠量化。【结果】队列开发数据集包括256,854-415,529例患者，2年累积发病率为0.12%-0.17%，而1:10匹配NCC数据集中约为9%。NCC设计通常产生更高的内部区分度，但时间性能因算法和索引日期定义而异。队列设计使LASSO达到最高的时间AUPRC（0.068），而以诊断锚定的NCC使XGBoost（0.086）和MLP（0.070）达到最高的时间AUPRC。随着诊断前所需提前时间增加，时间AUPRC通常下降。原始预测概率大幅高估了时间队列中的观察风险。等渗重校准改善了概率标度，同时基本保留了区分度，尽管仍存在残余校准不良。基于队列的特征排序在不同算法间更为一致，而基于NCC的排序更强烈地取决于算法和索引日期锚定。【结论】应根据预期的临床预测任务和部署环境选择并评估研究设计。

title: Trust, but Verify: Epistemic Uncertainty-Gated Pseudo-Labeling for Safer Semi-Supervised Malaria Screening
