abstract: [International journal of molecular sciences] Photodynamic therapy (PDT) is a minimally invasive therapeutic approach based on the light-induced activation of a photosensitizer in the presence of molecular oxygen, resulting in the generation of reactive oxygen species, including singlet oxygen. Despite local selectivity and low systemic toxicity, reproducibility of PDT is restricted by non-uniform accumulation of the photosensitizer, aggregation and insufficient solubility of compounds, variability in the optical properties of tissues, hypoxia, oxygen consumption, photobleaching, and the lack of a universal measure of photodynamic dose. Artificial intelligence (AI), including machine learning and deep learning, graph neural networks, generative models, Bayesian optimization, and physics-informed neural networks, can integrate molecular, spectral, imaging, dosimetric, omics, and clinical data into decision-support systems. In this review, a closed AI-PDT cycle is considered, which includes the in silico design of photosensitizers, optimization of nanoformulations and delivery, personalized light exposure planning, real-time monitoring of photobleaching and oxygenation, and prediction of efficacy, toxicity, immune response, and long-term outcomes. Particular attention is given to data quality, external validation, interpretability, uncertainty assessment, and clinical readiness. This review emphasizes that the greatest potential of AI in PDT lies in its integration with mechanistic models of photochemistry, light transport, and oxygen dynamics, enabling the transition from empirical treatment protocols toward adaptive, reproducible, and personalized photomedicine. Unlike reviews focused on individual AI applications, this work considers the entire AI-PDT workflow as an interconnected system linking molecular design, drug delivery, dosimetry, treatment monitoring, and outcome prediction, while maintaining clinician oversight and the need for experimental and clinical validation.
zh_abstract: [International Journal of Molecular Sciences] 光动力疗法（PDT）是一种微创治疗方法，基于在分子氧存在下光敏剂被光诱导激活，从而产生活性氧物种，包括单线态氧。尽管具有局部选择性和低全身毒性，PDT 的可重复性受到光敏剂蓄积不均匀、化合物聚集和溶解度不足、组织光学特性变异性、缺氧、氧消耗、光漂白以及缺乏普遍的光动力剂量衡量指标的限制。人工智能（AI），包括机器学习和深度学习、图神经网络、生成模型、贝叶斯优化和物理信息神经网络，可以将分子、光谱、成像、剂量学、组学和临床数据整合到决策支持系统中。本综述考虑了一个闭环 AI-PDT 循环，包括光敏剂的计算机模拟（in silico）设计、纳米制剂和递送的优化、个性化光照计划、光漂白和氧合的实时监测，以及疗效、毒性、免疫反应和长期结局的预测。特别关注数据质量、外部验证、可解释性、不确定性评估和临床就绪度。本综述强调，AI 在 PDT 中的最大潜力在于其与光化学、光传输和氧动力学的机制模型相整合，从而能够从经验性治疗方案转向自适应、可重复和个性化的光医学。与聚焦于单个 AI 应用的综述不同，本工作将整个 AI-PDT 工作流程视为一个相互关联的系统，连接分子设计、药物递送、剂量学、治疗监测和结局预测，同时保持临床医生的监督以及实验和临床验证的必要性。

abstract: Identifying lifespan-extending compounds is an important objective in ageing research, but experimental screening remains costly and time consuming. This study evaluates supervised machine learning for predicting lifespan-extending compounds in Caenorhabditis elegans using compound-protein interaction features derived from the STITCH database. Three feature representations were compared: continuous interaction probabilities, binary features generated using a fixed threshold of 0.5, and binary features generated using an optimised threshold selected within cross-validation. Random Forest and XGBoost classifiers were evaluated using stratified 10-fold cross-validation, with performance assessed by accuracy, area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC), and area under the precision recall curve (AUPRC). Model interpretation was examined using Mean Decrease in Impurity (MDI), SHAP, TreeSHAP, and LIME, with Jaccard similarity used to compare the top-ranked protein features. Random Forest achieved its highest accuracy (78.84%), AUROC (0.7391), and AUPRC (0.5202) using the fixed threshold binary representation. XGBoost achieved its highest accuracy (80.36%) using the optimised threshold representation, whereas continuous features yielded its highest AUROC (0.7605) and AUPRC (0.5332). SHAP and TreeSHAP showed the strongest agreement in protein rankings, producing identical top-10 feature sets across all three XGBoost representations. These findings demonstrate that feature representation influences both predictive performance and model interpretation, highlighting the importance of evaluating classification metrics alongside explainability when prioritising candidate compounds for further ageing research.
zh_abstract: 识别延长寿命的化合物是衰老研究中的一个重要目标，但实验筛选仍然昂贵且耗时。本研究评估监督式机器学习利用源自 STITCH 数据库的化合物-蛋白质相互作用特征，预测秀丽隐杆线虫（Caenorhabditis elegans）中延长寿命化合物的能力。比较了三种特征表示：连续相互作用概率、使用固定阈值 0.5 生成的二值特征，以及在交叉验证内选择优化阈值生成的二值特征。使用分层 10 折交叉验证评估 Random Forest 和 XGBoost 分类器，性能通过准确率、受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）和精确率-召回率曲线下面积（AUPRC）评估。使用平均不纯度减少（Mean Decrease in Impurity，MDI）、SHAP、TreeSHAP 和 LIME 考察模型解释，并用 Jaccard 相似度比较排名最高的蛋白质特征。Random Forest 在使用固定阈值二值表示时取得最高准确率（78.84%）、AUROC（0.7391）和 AUPRC（0.5202）。XGBoost 在使用优化阈值表示时取得最高准确率（80.36%），而连续特征使其取得最高 AUROC（0.7605）和 AUPRC（0.5332）。SHAP 与 TreeSHAP 在蛋白质排名上表现出最强一致性，在三种 XGBoost 表示下均产生相同的前 10 个特征集。这些发现表明，特征表示既影响预测性能也影响模型解释，突显了在为后续衰老研究优先筛选候选化合物时，将分类指标与可解释性一并评估的重要性。

title: Quality and transcript-grounded clinical-risk error burden of AI-generated vs allied health professional clinical notes: a paired simulation study across four disciplines

abstract: Background: Ambient artificial-intelligence (AI) scribes are being deployed beyond medicine into allied-health practice, but comparative evidence mainly concerns physician documentation. Objective: To compare quality and transcript-grounded clinical-risk error burden of AI-generated and allied health professional notes from identical simulated consultations. Methods: Paired simulation across dietetics, physiotherapy, occupational therapy and speech and language therapy (five consultations each; 20 pairs; 40 notes). Heidi generated an unedited first-draft note and a professional documented each encounter. Professionals rated PDQI-9 quality. Professional and automated review identified unsupported statements and omissions; two language models graded clinical risk. Co-primary outcomes were PDQI-9 score and Critical+High error density. Results: Mean PDQI-9 scores were 38.45 and 35.05 for AI and professional notes (paired difference +3.40, 95% CI +0.01 to +6.79; Wilcoxon p=0.042; dz=0.47). The Bayesian estimate was +3.47 (94% equal-tailed credible interval +0.66 to +6.30; P[AI>professional]=0.989). Automated-reviewer all-error density was 3.35 vs 8.55 per note (professional-minus-AI difference 5.20, 95% CI 3.85 to 6.55); omission density was 1.45 vs 5.20 (difference 3.75, 2.80 to 4.65). Critical+High density was 0.35 vs 0.75 (difference 0.40, -0.10 to 1.00). The pooled quality result was driven principally by dietetics. Conclusions: AI-generated notes achieved modestly higher pooled quality and fewer transcript-grounded errors, chiefly omissions; serious-error evidence was inconclusive. Small discipline samples and incomplete ground truth preclude safety or discipline-wide superiority claims.
zh_abstract: 【背景】环境式人工智能（AI）记录员正被部署到医学之外的专职医疗实践中，但比较证据主要涉及医生文书。【目的】在相同的模拟会诊中，比较 AI 生成记录与专职医疗专业人员记录的质量以及基于转录文本的临床风险错误负担。【方法】在营养学、物理治疗、职业治疗以及言语和语言治疗领域进行配对模拟（每个领域五次会诊；20 对；40 份记录）。Heidi 生成未经编辑的初稿记录，专业人员在每次会诊中记录。专业人员评定 PDQI-9 质量。专业人员和自动审查识别无依据陈述和遗漏；两个语言模型对临床风险进行分级。共同主要结局为 PDQI-9 评分和 Critical+High 错误密度。【结果】AI 记录和专业记录的平均 PDQI-9 评分分别为 38.45 和 35.05（配对差值 +3.40，95% CI +0.01 至 +6.79；Wilcoxon p=0.042；dz=0.47）。贝叶斯估计为 +3.47（94% 等尾可信区间 +0.66 至 +6.30；P[AI>professional]=0.989）。自动审查者的所有错误密度为每份记录 3.35 对 8.55（专业记录减 AI 记录差值 5.20，95% CI 3.85 至 6.55）；遗漏密度为 1.45 对 5.20（差值 3.75，2.80 至 4.65）。Critical+High 密度为 0.35 对 0.75（差值 0.40，-0.10 至 1.00）。汇总质量结果主要由营养学领域驱动。【结论】AI 生成记录获得了适度更高的汇总质量，并且基于转录文本的错误更少，主要是遗漏；严重错误证据尚无定论。各学科样本量小且真实基准不完整，因此不能声称其具有安全性或全学科范围内的优越性。

abstract: [Cancers] Digital three-dimensional (3D) visualization is an evolving field that is being introduced into pediatric surgical oncology, where it addresses challenges related to complex anatomy and difficulties accurately defining surgical margins. This paper provides an overview of digital 3D modeling in pediatric surgical oncology and explores ways to further advance this field. Digital 3D models may improve various aspects of surgery, such as preoperative planning, intraoperative guidance, patient education, and surgical training. Traditionally, 3D models are manually or semi-automatically segmented. More recently, artificial intelligence (AI) can automatically segment pediatric solid tumors. For preoperative planning, 3D models improve anatomic understanding and help multidisciplinary communication. During surgery, these models can assist the surgeon in accurately localizing tumors and determining resection margins in preclinical research settings. In patient education, 3D models present an opportunity to improve patient understanding of disease, therapy, and surgical risks. Lastly, digital 3D models are used in surgical training, particularly for challenging cases. Although digital 3D technologies are evaluated using technical performance metrics, these measures do not necessarily result in improved clinical outcomes. Consequently, evidence demonstrating improved surgical outcomes remains limited, also due to the small patient cohorts. Several challenges continue to hinder clinical translation, including image quality and standardization, segmentation complexity, organ deformability during surgery, and insufficient clinical validation. Addressing these limitations will require progress in four key areas: AI integration, multicenter validation, the development of centralized infrastructures including digital twins, and scalable implementation strategies that support widespread clinical adoption.
zh_abstract: [Cancers] 数字三维（3D）可视化是一个不断发展的领域，正被引入小儿外科肿瘤学，以应对与复杂解剖结构和准确界定手术切缘困难相关的挑战。本文概述了数字3D建模在小儿外科肿瘤学中的应用，并探讨了进一步推动该领域发展的方法。数字3D模型可改善手术的多个方面，例如术前规划、术中指导、患者教育和手术培训。传统上，3D模型通过手动或半自动分割。最近，人工智能（AI）可以自动分割小儿实体肿瘤。在术前规划方面，3D模型可增进解剖理解并帮助多学科沟通。在手术过程中，这些模型可在临床前研究环境中协助外科医生准确定位肿瘤并确定切除边缘。在患者教育方面，3D模型为提高患者对疾病、治疗和手术风险的理解提供了机会。最后，数字3D模型用于手术培训，尤其是具有挑战性的病例。尽管数字3D技术使用技术性能指标进行评估，但这些指标不一定带来临床结局的改善。因此，证明手术结局改善的证据仍然有限，这也是由于患者队列较小。若干挑战继续阻碍临床转化，包括图像质量和标准化、分割复杂性、手术期间的器官变形以及临床验证不足。解决这些局限性需要在四个关键领域取得进展：AI整合、多中心验证、包括数字孪生在内的集中式基础设施的开发，以及支持广泛临床采用的可扩展实施策略。

abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] Background/Objectives: Myocardial perfusion scintigraphy (MPS) is a cornerstone non-invasive imaging modality for assessing myocardial ischemia and infarction. This pilot study aimed to evaluate the feasibility of using ChatGPT-4 for automated preliminary clinical reporting in MPS and to identify specific scenarios in which large language model (LLM) performance is robust versus inadequate. Methods: A comparative analysis was conducted using 30 consecutive de-identified MPS cases spanning a broad spectrum of clinical scenarios. Structured clinical data were input into ChatGPT-4 to generate AI-based preliminary reports, which were then compared with reports prepared by two experienced nuclear medicine physicians. Reports were independently evaluated using four criteria-clinical accuracy, report structure, terminological appropriateness, and overall comprehensibility-scored on a 5-point Likert scale. Inter-observer agreement was assessed using Cohen's kappa. Results: ChatGPT-4 demonstrated strong performance in report structure (median 5), terminological appropriateness (median 4), and overall comprehensibility (median 5), consistently producing well-organized and coherent reports. However, clinical accuracy was significantly lower compared with physician reports (median 4 vs. 5; p = 0.002; effect size r = 0.52), particularly in complex cases such as multivessel ischemia and mixed pathologies, where outputs were occasionally superficial or lacked specificity. Inter-observer agreement between evaluating physicians was substantial (Cohen's κ = 0.78; 95% CI: 0.64-0.92). Conclusions: ChatGPT-4 shows promise as a supportive tool for preliminary MPS reporting and medical education, but its limitations in higher-order clinical reasoning necessitate careful human oversight. These findings are preliminary and require validation in adequately powered, multicenter studies before any clinical implementation.
zh_abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] 【背景/目的】心肌灌注闪烁显像（MPS）是评估心肌缺血和心肌梗死的基石性无创成像方式。本试点研究旨在评估使用ChatGPT-4在MPS中进行自动化初步临床报告撰写的可行性，并识别大语言模型（LLM）性能稳健与不足的具体场景。【方法】使用30例连续的去标识化MPS病例进行对比分析，涵盖广泛的临床场景。将结构化临床数据输入ChatGPT-4以生成基于AI的初步报告，然后与两名经验丰富的核医学医师撰写的报告进行比较。使用四项标准独立评估报告——临床准确性、报告结构、术语适当性和整体可理解性——采用5点Likert量表评分。使用Cohen's kappa评估观察者间一致性。【结果】ChatGPT-4在报告结构（中位数5）、术语适当性（中位数4）和整体可理解性（中位数5）方面表现出色，始终生成组织良好且连贯的报告。然而，与医师报告相比，临床准确性显著较低（中位数4 vs. 5；p = 0.002；效应量 r = 0.52），尤其是在多支血管缺血和混合性病变等复杂病例中，其输出偶尔流于表面或缺乏特异性。评估医师之间的观察者间一致性较强（Cohen's κ = 0.78；95% CI：0.64-0.92）。【结论】ChatGPT-4作为MPS初步报告和医学教育的支持工具显示出前景，但其在更高阶临床推理方面的局限性需要仔细的人工监督。这些发现是初步的，需要在样本量足够的多中心研究中进行验证，之后才能进行任何临床实施。

abstract: Medical image classifiers typically return predictions without a native contract for independently reconstructing their spatial decision computation. Evidence Field is a trainable spatial-program architecture that jointly produces class scores, selected covering programs and signed evidence. Its encoder combines absolute and image-relative response fields with associative spatial moments and learned characteristic sums. A typed classifier scores individual regions and parent-conditioned multiplicative groups; a covering recursion selects scale, partition and composition. We establish exact one-fold coverage, optimality within the registered grammar, a bound relating smooth training to hard inference, signed-score conservation and class-centred offset invariance. Direct contractions and their adjoint specify arithmetic and storage scaling on two- and three-dimensional grids. Native output records bind inputs, parameters, supports, types and contextual dependencies to individual and ensemble predictions. In a separately reported histopathology application, patient-separated training and evaluation across held-out centres provide empirical evidence for the architecture. Trained mechanism and corrected-loss comparisons distinguish predictive effects from implementation correctness; independent readers reconstruct descriptors, routes, scores and probability mixtures. The principal contribution is a coupled representation, decision and evidence architecture whose selected computation can be reproduced independently.
zh_abstract: 医学图像分类器通常只返回预测结果，而不附带可独立重建其空间决策计算的原生契约。Evidence Field 是一种可训练的空间程序架构，可联合生成类别分数、选定的覆盖程序和有符号证据。其编码器将绝对响应场和图像相对响应场与关联空间矩及学习到的特征和相结合。类型化分类器对单个区域以及以父级为条件的乘法群进行评分；覆盖递归选择尺度、划分和组合。我们建立了精确的单重覆盖、注册语法内的最优性、将平滑训练与硬推理联系起来的界、有符号分数守恒以及以类别为中心的偏移不变性。直接收缩及其伴随指定了二维和三维网格上的算术和存储缩放。原生输出记录将输入、参数、支持集、类型和上下文依赖绑定到个体预测和集成预测。在一项单独报告的组织病理学应用中，跨留出中心进行患者分离的训练和评估，为该架构提供了经验证据。训练机制和校正损失比较将预测效应与实现正确性区分开来；独立读者重建描述符、路径、分数和概率混合。主要贡献是一个耦合表示、决策和证据的架构，其选定的计算可以独立复现。

title: From Prediction to Action: Population Health World Model for Digital Medicine
zh_title: 从预测到行动：数字医学的人群健康世界模型
summary: 预印本观点文章主张数字医学应从任务化预测转向可表征干预如何改变未来健康轨迹的世界模型。
key_points: 整合电子病历、可穿戴与遥感等多源数据

abstract: Digital medicine now captures data that traces individual health trajectories and reveals population health dynamics through electronic health records, claims, remote monitoring, wearable devices, mobile devices, social sensing data, medical images, etc. But much of its modeling still centers on task-specific, outcome-specific, and prediction-specific estimation. The next frontier is not simply better prediction, but action in an evolving health world shaped by multiple decision-makers, heterogeneous populations, resource constraints, and feedback in care delivery. This is why digital medicine now needs world models: not only to estimate what will happen, but to represent how actions change what can happen next -- whom to prioritize, how to allocate scarce resources, how to adapt care across subgroups, and how interventions reshape future health trajectories and population dynamics. We call such a model population health world model (PHWM): a more foundational representation of an evolving health world in which health states, individual trajectories, population health dynamics, interventions, constraints, and feedback are intrinsically coupled. Building a PHWM endows three unmet structural gaps in current digital medicine: dynamic health-state modeling, population-level intervention intelligence, and validation, equity, and governance for action-oriented use. We argue that addressing these gaps requires three minimal capabilities: representation learning under action-dependent observation, multi-scale intervention intelligence, and validation with explicit decision boundaries, while highlighting the importance of social, contextual, and public-health sensing data for action-oriented digital medicine.
zh_abstract: 数字医学现在捕获的数据可通过电子健康记录、理赔数据、远程监测、可穿戴设备、移动设备、社会感知数据、医学图像等，追踪个体健康轨迹并揭示群体健康动态。但其建模的很大一部分仍集中于任务特定、结局特定和预测特定的估计。下一个前沿不只是更好的预测，而是在一个由多重决策者、异质人群、资源约束和照护提供反馈所塑造的不断演变的健康世界中的行动。这就是为什么数字医学现在需要世界模型：不仅估计将会发生什么，还要表征行动如何改变接下来可能发生什么——优先考虑谁、如何分配稀缺资源、如何针对不同亚组调整照护，以及干预如何重塑未来健康轨迹和人群动态。我们将此类模型称为人群健康世界模型（population health world model, PHWM）：它是对不断演变的健康世界更基础的表征，其中健康状态、个体轨迹、人群健康动态、干预、约束和反馈内在耦合。构建PHWM可弥补当前数字医学中三个尚未满足的结构性缺口：动态健康状态建模、人群层面干预智能，以及面向行动用途的验证、公平性和治理。我们认为，弥补这些缺口需要三项最低能力：动作依赖观察下的表征学习、多尺度干预智能，以及具有明确决策边界的验证；同时强调社会、情境和公共卫生感知数据对面向行动的数字医学的重要性。

title: Pronouncing Hard Words: Phoneme Adaptation of a Pretrained Conversational Text to Speech Model
zh_title: 预训练对话TTS的音素适配：难词发音控制
summary: 预印本通过音素词表扩展与推理期声学偏置，提升对话TTS对临床药物名称的发音准确率。
key_points: 在预训练对话TTS上免预训练加音素可控性
7,500条临床药物发音评测集
严格判定正确率由54.6%提升
reason: 预印本单一任务改进，无临床结局验证，属增量档
abstract: Voice agents built as cascaded automatic speech recognition (ASR)->large language model (LLM)-> text-to-speech (TTS) pipelines increasingly rely on conversational TTS: streaming, context conditioned models that adapt delivery to dialogue history. Such models are natural and expressive but offer little explicit control over how rare, trust-critical drug names are pronounced, because these entities are too infrequent, and their vocabulary too fast-growing, to be covered by any amount of pre-, mid-, or post-training. We retrofit phoneme controllability onto a pretrained conversational TTS model without any pre/mid-training, using an ARPAbet vocabulary exten-sion, continued phoneme-augmented supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and a training-free inference-time acoustic-biasing step. On a 7,500 clip clinical drug-pronunciation evaluation, our model raises strict Gemini-judged correctness from 54.6% (no phoneme augmentation) to 90.7%, outperforming every conversational and stateless TTS baseline on the automatic metric. Because no training stage sees a drug name, the entire evaluation is out-of-domain, so the gains reflect learned pronunciation rather than memorization. In a blinded, randomized human study, adult listeners judge 84% of our clips correct, versus 82% for the strongest baseline, with overlapping confidence intervals on a stratified subset. Across all 250 matched clips, Gemini agrees with the human majority on 84.8% of binary labels (k{appa}=0.57).
zh_abstract: 作为级联自动语音识别（automatic speech recognition, ASR）->大语言模型（large language model, LLM）->文本转语音（text-to-speech, TTS）流水线构建的语音智能体，越来越依赖对话式 TTS：即流式、上下文条件化、能够根据对话历史调整表达方式的模型。这类模型自然且富有表现力，但对罕见且对信任至关重要的药物名称如何发音几乎不提供显式控制，因为这些实体过于低频，且其词汇增长过快，任何数量的预训练、中期训练或后训练都无法覆盖。我们在没有任何预训练/中期训练的情况下，将音素可控性改造到预训练的对话式 TTS 模型上，使用 ARPAbet 词表扩展、持续的音素增强监督微调（supervised fine-tuning, SFT）以及无需训练的推理时声学偏置步骤。在 7,500 条片段的临床药物发音评估中，我们的模型将严格的 Gemini 判定正确率从 54.6%（无音素增强）提高到 90.7%，在自动指标上优于所有对话式和无状态 TTS 基线。由于任何训练阶段都未见过药物名称，整个评估均为域外，因此增益反映的是学习到的发音而非记忆。在一项盲法随机人体研究中，成年听者判定我们的片段有 84% 正确，而最强基线为 82%，在分层子集上置信区间重叠。在所有 250 条匹配片段中，Gemini 在 84.8% 的二元标签上与人类多数意见一致（k{appa}=0.57）。

abstract: Evaluating a fine-tuned coaching model with expert graders is slow and expensive, and an LLM judge cannot be trusted without ground truth. We present a staged pipeline that screens candidate LLM judges and student models before expert review, using explicit decision rules at each stage: judge output audit, similarity with hosted judges, bias checks, and decision robustness. We demonstrate it on an AI dental hygiene coach. The case study uses synthetic, clinically unvalidated training and reference data to demonstrate the operation of the pipeline, rather than to establish the clinical performance of the resulting models. Two fine-tuned small language models (Granite-4.1-8B and Qwen3-8B), each trained at three data sizes, were scored on seven metrics by five judges (three local, two hosted). Two local judges, Qwen3.8-27B and Gemma-4-31B-it, were not distinguishable from the agreement between the hosted judges on six of seven metrics by rank correlation, and Qwen3.8-27B was the most similar to the hosted judges overall. No judge met our criterion for favoring its own model family or training-data source. The student comparison did not separate the two models on any metric under the pipeline's rule, so the choice of Granite-4.1-8B, which led in 29 of 35 judge-by-metric cells, is a lean that depends partly on truncated Qwen3-8B outputs. The pipeline also surfaced problems that raw scores hid, including the truncated outputs and hallucination flags from one hosted judge that no other judge corroborated. No dental hygiene expert has graded these responses, so the findings are preliminary and the pipeline's final stage, anchoring to expert judgement, is proposed but not performed.
zh_abstract: 用专家评分者评估微调后的辅导模型既慢又昂贵，而 LLM 评判者在没有真实基准的情况下不可信。我们提出一个分阶段流程，在专家审查之前筛选候选 LLM 评判者和学生模型，并在每个阶段使用明确的决策规则：评判者输出审计、与托管评判者的一致性、偏差检查和决策稳健性。我们在一个 AI 口腔卫生辅导器上演示了该流程。该案例研究使用合成的、未经临床验证的训练和参考数据来演示流程的运行，而非确立所得模型的临床性能。两个微调小型语言模型（Granite-4.1-8B 和 Qwen3-8B），各自在三种数据规模下训练，由五名评判者（三名本地、两名托管）按七项指标评分。两名本地评判者 Qwen3.8-27B 和 Gemma-4-31B-it 在七项指标中的六项上，按秩相关无法与托管评判者之间的一致性区分开来，而 Qwen3.8-27B 总体上与托管评判者最相似。没有评判者达到我们关于偏袒自身模型家族或训练数据来源的标准。在该流程规则下，学生模型比较未能在任何指标上区分两个模型，因此选择 Granite-4.1-8B（其在 35 个评判者×指标单元中的 29 个领先）是一种倾向，部分取决于 Qwen3-8B 输出被截断。该流程还揭示了原始分数所掩盖的问题，包括输出被截断，以及一名托管评判者给出的幻觉标记未得到其他任何评判者佐证。尚无口腔卫生专家对这些回答进行评分，因此这些发现是初步的，且该流程的最终阶段——锚定专家判断——已被提出但尚未执行。

title: Cross-Dimension and Cross-Modality Relational Tensor Representation Learning for Multimodal Health Data Modeling

abstract: Multimodal health data integrate information from heterogeneous clinical sources, creating substantial opportunities for data-driven decision support. Realizing these opportunities, however, requires effectively modeling complex dependencies that arise both within individual modalities and across modalities. This paper proposes Relational Tensor Representation (RTR), a unified framework that jointly learns dimension-specific tensor representations and cross-dimensional and cross-modality relationships. RTR introduces learnable relational bridge matrices that maintain relational information while preserving the structural identities of tensor dimensions and modalities. A structured fusion mechanism further integrates factor-level and relationship-level information into compact representations for downstream prediction. Experiments on simulated data and two multimodal neurophysiological datasets, covering emotion recognition and brain activity classification, demonstrate that RTR consistently outperforms representative tensor learning, multimodal fusion, and Transformer-based baselines. These results highlight the value of explicitly modeling cross-dimensional and cross-modality relationships for learning informative representations from heterogeneous multimodal tensor data. The source code is planned for public release to support reproducibility and future research.
zh_abstract: 多模态健康数据整合来自异构临床来源的信息，为数据驱动的决策支持创造了重要机会。然而，要真正实现这些机会，需要有效建模单个模态内部以及跨模态出现的复杂依赖关系。本文提出关系张量表示（Relational Tensor Representation, RTR），一个统一框架，可联合学习维度特定的张量表示以及跨维度和跨模态关系。RTR 引入可学习的关系桥接矩阵，在保持张量维度和模态的结构身份的同时维持关系信息。结构化融合机制进一步将因子级和关系级信息整合为紧凑表示，用于下游预测。在模拟数据和两个多模态神经生理数据集（涵盖情绪识别和脑活动分类）上的实验表明，RTR 始终优于具有代表性的张量学习、多模态融合和基于 Transformer 的基线。这些结果凸显了显式建模跨维度和跨模态关系对于从异构多模态张量数据中学习有信息量表示的价值。源代码计划公开发布，以支持可复现性和未来研究。

abstract: Automatic Speech recognition (ASR) struggles with Pathological speech due to persistent speaker-specific mismatch. In clinical and accessibility scenarios, only limited target-speaker data is typically available, making full model retraining impractical. We present a component-level analysis of LoRA adaptation in Whisper, investigating how adapter placement interacts with the model size, training efficiency and utterance-duration in single-speaker settings. Our experimental comparative study shows that while scaling reduces errors, it does not eliminate mismatch. Furthermore, the full attention LoRa provides the most reliable accuracy, and the best time--accuracy trade-off. Improvements vary across utterance length, with medium-length recordings benefiting the most, while short and long utterances remain challenging. These findings highlight the importance of adaptation placement and duration-dependent evaluation, under challenging, data-scarce personalization scenarios.
zh_abstract: 自动语音识别（Automatic Speech Recognition, ASR）因持续存在的说话人特异性失配而在病理性语音上面临困难。在临床和可及性场景中，通常只能获得有限的目标说话人数据，使得完整模型重新训练不切实际。我们对 Whisper 中的 LoRA 适配进行了组件级分析，研究在单说话人设置下适配器放置如何与模型规模、训练效率和话语时长相互作用。我们的实验比较研究表明，虽然扩展规模可以降低错误，但并不能消除失配。此外，全注意力 LoRA 提供了最可靠的准确率和最佳的时间-准确率权衡。改进程度随话语长度而变化，中等长度录音获益最大，而短话语和长话语仍然具有挑战性。这些发现凸显了在具有挑战性、数据稀缺的个性化场景中，适配放置和时长相关评估的重要性。

title: Enhancing RAG-based Medical VQA with Gated Multimodal Representations

abstract: Medical Vision-Language Models (Med-LVLMs) have shown strong performance in Medical Visual Question Answering (MVQA), yet they may still produce factually inconsistent responses. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) can mitigate this issue by incorporating external clinical evidence; however, retrieval is often guided by a single modality, potentially overlooking the joint semantics of medical images and clinical questions. We introduce a multimodal RAG framework that learns a joint query representation through a Gated Multimodal Unit, enabling evidence retrieval to leverage information from both modalities while keeping the underlying Med-LVLM frozen. We evaluate the proposed approach on benchmark datasets. Results show that the multimodal query representation consistently outperforms a reference Med-LVLM and remains competitive with state-of-the-art methods. Our findings demonstrate the potential of multimodal query representations for more effective evidence retrieval in Medical VQA.
zh_abstract: 医学视觉语言模型（Medical Vision-Language Models, Med-LVLMs）在医学视觉问答（Medical Visual Question Answering, MVQA）中已表现出强劲性能，但仍可能产生事实不一致的回答。检索增强生成（Retrieval-Augmented Generation, RAG）可通过纳入外部临床证据来缓解这一问题；然而，检索通常由单一模态引导，可能忽视医学图像和临床问题的联合语义。我们引入一种多模态 RAG 框架，通过门控多模态单元（Gated Multimodal Unit）学习联合查询表示，使证据检索能够利用来自两种模态的信息，同时保持底层 Med-LVLM 冻结。我们在基准数据集上评估所提方法。结果表明，多模态查询表示始终优于参考 Med-LVLM，并与最先进方法保持竞争力。我们的发现证明了多模态查询表示在医学 VQA 中实现更有效证据检索的潜力。

abstract: [Nutrients] Large language models (LLMs) can answer dietary questions, but their use as substitutes for registered dietitians remains insufficiently quantified. Evaluations have identified inaccurate nutrient targets, incomplete clinical advice, and insufficient personalization, alongside useful performance on some general nutrition tasks. Social media and food-delivery interfaces may also influence dietary choices through food cues, social endorsement, and choice architecture. This conceptual perspective presents ADRIFT (Algorithmic Dietary Reconfiguration through Informational, Framing, and Technological mechanisms) to examine how these influences might interact. Drawing on a targeted, nonsystematic synthesis of nutrition, behavioral, neuroscience, and AI literature, ADRIFT distinguishes three axes: informational errors and unsupported advice; framing through content and interface design; and adaptive personalization and cognitive delegation. Direct evidence supports selected component mechanisms, but their convergence into a feedback loop that reduces nutritional autonomy remains hypothetical. We propose a six-category taxonomy covering hallucinations and related nutrition errors, define nutritional autonomy erosion as declining capacity for informed, self-directed dietary decisions, and outline eight testable hypotheses. The framework concerns unsupervised use and does not predict that language models will replace dietetic professionals. Longitudinal validation, platform experiments, and clinical safety evaluations are needed to determine whether, for whom, and under which conditions the proposed harms occur.
